name: SEO Rulebook
summary: Being found: technical SEO, content signals, structured data and what search engines penalise.
check: View source for head tags; validate structured data; Lighthouse SEO.
Crawl the site for broken links, redirects and noindex.
Submit the sitemap in Search Console.

rules.title: Sitemap
rules.text: A `sitemap.xml` lists every public page and is linked from robots.txt.

rules.title: robots.txt
rules.text: A `robots.txt` allows the public site and blocks private areas.

rules.title: Stray noindex
rules.text: Make sure no public page still carries a `noindex` left from development.

rules.title: Canonical tags
rules.text: One canonical URL per page (`<link rel="canonical">`).

rules.title: Unique meta title per page
rules.text: Specific, about 60 characters at most.

rules.title: Unique meta description per page
rules.text: About 155 characters, written to earn the click.

rules.title: One H1 per page
rules.text: Each page has exactly one H1 that states what the page is about.

rules.title: Logical heading order
rules.text: H1 → H2 → H3, no skipped levels for styling reasons.

rules.title: Alt text on meaningful images
rules.text: Every meaningful image has alt text; purely decorative images have an empty `alt=""`.

rules.title: Schema markup
rules.text: JSON-LD for the relevant types: Organization, Product, Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, LocalBusiness.

rules.title: Internal links
rules.text: Related pages link to each other with descriptive anchor text.

rules.title: Broken links
rules.text: Check every internal and external link before launch.

rules.title: Clean URL slugs
rules.text: `/shop/m1-puffer`, not `/page?id=8273`.

rules.title: HTTPS everywhere
rules.text: Every page is served over HTTPS, with a permanent redirect from http.

rules.title: Search Console verified
rules.text: The site is verified in Google Search Console and the sitemap is submitted.

rules.title: llms.txt
rules.text: An `llms.txt` at the site root gives a short plain description of the site and links to its key pages for AI assistants.

rules.title: Server-rendered content
rules.text: Main content and links are in the HTML the server sends (static or server-rendered), not only built by JavaScript in the browser.

rules.title: 301 redirects for moved pages
rules.text: Changed URLs redirect permanently to the new address; nothing important returns 404 after a redesign.

rules.title: Real 404 status
rules.text: Missing pages return HTTP 404 (not 200 with an error message), so they are not indexed as "soft 404s".

rules.title: Descriptive image file names
rules.text: `m1-puffer-jacket-black.avif`, not `IMG_2381.jpg`.

rules.title: Breadcrumbs with structured data
rules.text: Deeper pages show breadcrumbs and mark them up as BreadcrumbList.

rules.title: Show who is behind the site
rules.text: About, contact and author information make the site trustworthy to people and search engines.

rules.title: Local business consistency
rules.text: Local businesses keep name, address and phone identical on the site, Google Business Profile and directories, and add LocalBusiness schema with opening hours.

rules.title: Accurate sitemap dates
rules.text: `lastmod` in the sitemap changes only when the page content really changes.

rules.title: Intrusive interstitials
rules.text: No pop-up that covers the main content right after arriving from search, especially on phones. Legal banners (cookies, age checks) are the exception.

rules.title: Duplicate pages
rules.text: No identical content under several URLs (with and without slash, parameters, http and https). Pick one and point canonicals and redirects to it.

rules.title: Keyword stuffing and hidden text
rules.text: No repeated keywords for search engines, no text hidden from people. Write for readers.

rules.title: Doorway pages
rules.text: No near-identical pages for every city or keyword. One good page per real offer.

rules.title: Orphan pages
rules.text: Every page that should rank is linked from at least one other page and listed in the sitemap.
